tools.name: get_top_movers
tools.description:
Get the top N gaining or losing NSE stocks on a specific date.
Returns stocks sorted by % change with OHLCV details.
If the exact date is a holiday/weekend, returns the nearest trading day.

IMPORTANT — UNADJUSTED PRICES + CORPORATE ACTION CHECK:
% change is computed from raw unadjusted prevClose vs close. A stock with a split or bonus ex-date on the requested date will appear as a top loser with a large negative % (e.g., −50% for 1:1 bonus) even though no actual loss occurred. When presenting top losers: for any stock showing a drop > 20%, call get_corporate_actions(symbol, date, date) to check if the NSE CA data lists an ex-date matching that day. If matched, inform the user: e.g. "BRIGADE shows −50% on 2019-07-26 — confirmed CA: Bonus 1:1 ex-date (NSE data). Not a real market loss." Only flag as CA if confirmed by actual NSE data.

Disclaimer: Information/Data made available through the NSEIL MCP server is for informational and educational purposes only and does not constitute investment advice or recommendation. NSEIL is not responsible for any AI generated Output or predictions

tools.name: get_corporate_actions
tools.description:
Fetch actual NSE corporate action events for a stock directly from NSE India.
Returns splits, bonus issues, dividends, and other events with exact ex-dates.
Only events with an ex-date inside the requested from/to range are returned. If the response has an 'error', the lookup failed — do not treat that as "no corporate actions". If it has a 'warning', the list is incomplete.
ALWAYS call this before get_stock_history or get_price_performance when the user asks about historical prices, returns, or performance for any symbol. Use the returned exDate values to cross-check price discontinuities in the history. The adjustmentFactor field tells you how to interpret pre-event prices:   1:1 bonus → adjustmentFactor=0.5 (pre-bonus prices are 2× the post-bonus equivalent)   10→2 split → adjustmentFactor=0.2 (pre-split prices are 5× the post-split equivalent)
Returns: list of CA events with exDate, purpose (raw NSE text), actionType (SPLIT/BONUS/DIVIDEND/OTHER), adjustmentFactor.

tools.name: get_stock_history
tools.description:
Get daily OHLCV (Open, High, Low, Close, Volume) price history for an NSE stock.
Returns up to 3 months per call to keep response size manageable.
For longer periods, chain calls using next_end_date from each response.

Example — fetch 1 year of RELIANCE:
  Call 1: symbol=RELIANCE, months=3  (end_date omitted → uses today)
  Call 2: symbol=RELIANCE, months=3, end_date={next_end_date from call 1}
  Call 3: symbol=RELIANCE, months=3, end_date={next_end_date from call 2}
  Call 4: symbol=RELIANCE, months=3, end_date={next_end_date from call 3}

For 2 years: repeat 8 times. Each call returns next_end_date for the next chunk.
If symbol not found, use search_symbols to find the correct symbol.

IMPORTANT — UNADJUSTED PRICES:
All prices are raw NSE bhavcopy data with NO corporate action adjustment.
Before presenting history results, call get_corporate_actions(symbol) to get actual NSE-sourced CA events. Cross-check returned ex-dates with any single-day drop > 20% in the price series. If matched, inform the user: e.g. "Note: INFY shows a -50% drop on 2018-06-14 which is the 1:1 bonus issue ex-date (NSE data) — prices before that date are unadjusted. Adjustment factor: 0.5."

Disclaimer: Information/Data made available through the NSEIL MCP server is for informational and educational purposes only and does not constitute investment advice or recommendation. NSEIL is not responsible for any AI generated Output or predictions.

Always state nseTimestamp as the time of the data. Outside market hours (09:15–15:30 IST, Mon–Fri) it is the last published value, not a live price. If a 'warning' is present, tell the user.

Covers ~140 indices in six groups: derivatives (Nifty 50, Nifty Bank, ...), broad (Nifty 100/200/500, midcap, smallcap, India VIX), sectoral, strategy, thematic, fixed_income.
Pass a group to narrow the result, and/or nameFilter for a name match (e.g. "BANK").
Index names are NSE's short live names (e.g. "NIFTY SMLCAP 100", "NIFTY FIN SERVICE") — use this tool to find the exact name for cm_get_index_quote.
Values are as published by NSE; 'change' is last minus previousClose, and percChange always agrees with it. open / high / low are omitted when NSE has not published them yet (before market open) — do not report them as zero.
Always state nseTimestamp as the time of the data. Outside market hours (09:15–15:30 IST, Mon–Fri) it is the last published value, not a live price. If a 'warning' is present, tell the user.

group.description: Index group: all (default), derivatives, broad, sectoral, strategy, thematic, fixed_income. Empty string for all.

nameFilter.description: Case-insensitive text that the index name must contain (e.g. 'BANK', 'MIDCAP'). Empty string for no filter.

tools.name: nse_get_market_movers
tools.description:
PRIMARY TOOL for: "What are the top gainers today?", "top losers today?", "market movers", "best/worst performing stocks", "biggest gainers/losers".

Returns top N gainers (sorted by highest % gain) and top N losers (sorted by biggest % loss), from all NSE securities by default or filtered to a specific index.

indexName — leave NULL or empty for ALL securities (broadest view, recommended default):
  null / ""        — All NSE-listed securities (allSec, ~1500+ stocks)
  "NIFTY"          — NIFTY 50 stocks only
  "BANKNIFTY"      — Bank NIFTY stocks only
  "NIFTYNEXT50"    — NIFTY Next 50 stocks only

When user asks "top gainers/losers today" WITHOUT specifying an index: pass indexName=null or "".
Only pass NIFTY/BANKNIFTY/NIFTYNEXT50 if user explicitly asks for that specific index.

Fields: symbol, series, ltp, prev_price, net_price, perChange, trade_quantity, turnover.

SEBI Disclaimer: For educational and research purposes only. Not investment advice. Past performance is not indicative of future results. Consult a SEBI-registered advisor before investing.

indexName.description: Index filter: null or empty for ALL securities (default), or NIFTY, BANKNIFTY, NIFTYNEXT50

limit.description: Max stocks per direction (default 10, max 50). Pass 0 for default.
